screenshots.name: 01-guest
screenshots.caption: A signed-out visitor sees the team invitation and login/register choices.

screenshots.name: 02-after-registration
screenshots.caption: Registration signs the visitor in and returns directly to Accept or Decline.

screenshots.name: 03-team-accepted
screenshots.caption: An explicit acceptance adds the new account to the team.

screenshots.name: 03a-team-management
screenshots.caption: Team details show the single permanent invitation link with a Copy button.

screenshots.name: 03b-new-team
screenshots.caption: A new user without a team creates one within the match invitation, then can accept.

screenshots.name: 04-match-choice
screenshots.caption: An existing user logs in, returns to the match request, and chooses a team they lead.

screenshots.name: 05-match-accepted
screenshots.caption: Accepting the request creates the match and participant bookings.

screenshots.name: 06-lobby-joined
screenshots.caption: The lobby link joins the signed-in player using the normal capacity checks.

screenshots.name: 07-declined
screenshots.caption: Declining records the response without creating a membership or booking.

screenshots.name: 08-closed
screenshots.caption: Links keep their URL but a canceled match request blocks acceptance.

screenshots.name: 09-mobile
screenshots.caption: The invitation is usable on a narrow mobile screen.

screenshots.name: 10-owner-link
screenshots.caption: The owner sees the same permanent team URL; there is no invitation management dialog.

screenshots.name: 11-lobby-link
screenshots.caption: The lobby creator sees one stable join URL with a Copy button.

screenshots.name: 12-match-link
screenshots.caption: The posting team's leader sees one stable match-request URL with a Copy button.

screenshots.name: 13-cancel-confirmation
screenshots.caption: The posting team's leader can cancel an open request after confirmation.

screenshots.name: 14-request-canceled
screenshots.caption: The request becomes canceled and can no longer be accepted.
